$comment: Brainforge is packaged as a Claude plugin from day one (DESIGN.md §6B). The BUILDER layer (commands/) is Claude-first; the brain it scaffolds (scaffold/) is tool-agnostic markdown+JSON readable by any LLM.
name: brainforge
description: Build and operate a product-org brain — a tool-agnostic git repo of authored truth + synced facts that any LLM can read.

runtime.$comment: The seam. Files re-emittable on /upgrade (commands/upgrade.md) — the bumpable behavior layer, like react-scripts. Everything else in scaffold/ is emitted once and owned by the brain. Emitted brains carry .brainforge/runtime-manifest.json (this version + sha256 per bump file, hashed as emitted) — the baseline /upgrade compares against. Corollary: touching a bump path here means bumping version above, or the change is invisible to upgrades.

publish.$comment: The distribution seam (Phase 4). include = allowlist globs copied verbatim; anything unmatched is private by default. map = authored public variants renamed at emit (never scrub the private originals). Corollary: touching a published path means re-running /publish before the next release. Second corollary: touching published BEHAVIOR (commands/**, .claude-plugin/**, scaffold/**, synapse/** — anything an install executes, dispatches on, or emits) means bumping version above, or the change is invisible to `claude plugin update` and installed users keep the old behavior until a forced reinstall. Docs-only published paths and evals/** need the re-publish but not the bump. See CONTRIBUTING.md's three corollary rules. The audit leak-denylist lives in publish-audit.json at repo root — private by design (matched by no include glob), so the denylist never ships with the set it polices.
